algorithm_contract.message_equation: root-transformed node feature plus relation-specific transformed neighbor features normalized within relation

node_representation_modes.feature_based: floating-point node features with a common frozen dimensionality
node_representation_modes.node_index_based: integer node indices or x=None are treated as trainable entity embeddings tied to the fitted node universe

paper.title: Modeling Relational Data with Graph Convolutional Networks

algorithm_contract.relation_contract: edge_type is a one-dimensional integer relation ID in [0,num_relations). Direction and inverse direction require separately frozen relation IDs.

checkpoint_contract.fitted_artifact: project-generated per outer split, held-source role, and seed; not yet created
checkpoint_contract.warning: The pinned PyG object is a convolution layer, not a trained R-GCN model. A decoder, loss, graph construction, and calibration are separate project artifacts.

held_source_output_contract.admissible_output: one source-agnostic continuous candidate-gene score per frozen row, later calibrated without the held source
held_source_output_contract.held_relation_parameter_rule: If one evidence source is encoded as its own relation, removing every edge of that relation leaves its RGCN transformation and any relation-specific decoder embedding untrained. Those parameters cannot be used to claim recovery of the unseen source.
held_source_output_contract.native_layer_output: one embedding tensor for graph nodes
held_source_output_contract.required_decoder: A frozen source-agnostic gene-ranking decoder trained on eligible labels from remaining development sources only. It may not receive a held-source ID, relation embedding, observability mask, or outcome-derived candidate universe.
held_source_output_contract.task_interpretation: Recovery means cross-source prioritization after complete source removal, not completion of an unseen relation type.

inductive_transductive_contract.feature_based_operator: Conditionally inductive for new nodes when their features are produced by a frozen source-independent transform and all relation IDs and dimensions were trained.
inductive_transductive_contract.node_index_mode: Transductive. Learned entity embeddings cannot score a node absent from the fitted graph snapshot.
inductive_transductive_contract.official_link_prediction_example: Transductive: it allocates one learned embedding per node and one DistMult embedding per relation.
inductive_transductive_contract.project_default: Use feature-based mode for any unseen-node claim. A transductive fixed-node-universe lane may be reported separately but cannot imply induction to a new gene, locus, node type, or relation.
inductive_transductive_contract.source_only_node_rule: A node whose existence is learned only from the held source cannot remain as an input node. Retaining it leaks held-source coverage even if incident edges are deleted.

input_contract.continuous_edge_features: unsupported_by_RGCNConv_forward; the API accepts edge_index and edge_type but no per-edge weight or feature tensor
input_contract.edge_direction: native through directed edge_index; reverse messages require explicit inverse relation types
input_contract.evidence_values: Continuous assay strength, provenance confidence, tested-negative status, and missingness are not natively consumed as edge attributes. Any encoding as node features or relation bins is a separately frozen project design.
input_contract.graph: one split-safe relation-labeled graph built only from permitted training sources and loci
input_contract.node_features: source-independent or remaining-source features fit inside the outer training role; no held-source outcomes, observability, degree, or coverage indicators
input_contract.node_types: RGCNConv uses one node tensor, not type-specific feature spaces. Node type must be represented by frozen features or relation structure without outcome leakage.

runtime_contract.optional_kernels: PyG documents pyg-lib, torch-scatter, torch-sparse, torch-cluster, and torch-spline-conv as optional; the exact installed path changes kernels and must be frozen.
runtime_contract.slurm_rule: No runtime or model probe before an approved campaign.

safe_loading_contract.state_dict_rule: Strict-load only project-generated tensor state into the frozen architecture. Do not deserialize arbitrary pickle-backed PyTorch objects.

source_evidence: The R-GCN paper, exact PyG 2.7.0 release commit, RGCNConv source, official link-prediction example, package metadata, and MIT license were inspected online on 2026-08-22. No package, graph, checkpoint, or weights were downloaded, installed, or run.

terms_audit.project_weight_redistribution: Code terms permit redistribution with notice, but a fitted artifact may encode project graph data. Release requires source-data rights review and the benchmark's dataset-level derivative-use review.
